necessary_context.content: Finite pool of binary predictors. All pool predictions precede the master prediction; the binary label is then supplied to master and pool. No probabilistic sequence assumption.

necessary_context.content: Default initial weights are one. w_init and w_fin denote total initial/final weights. Sequences are finite. Logarithm ratios use a common base. Corollaries after Theorem 2.1 assume beta>0 and unit initialization; WM additionally requires beta<1.
